scope: Historical paper valuation and risk; Phase 4 and G2-G6 remain incomplete

tests.hosted_checks: Pre-push record. Exact-head hosted results belong to the PR checks and description.

checks.dependency_audits: runtime, research and development: zero known vulnerabilities

covered_behaviours: Original-time fill fees, balances and validated GBP bid NAV before financial import
Peak, crash and rebound in a single batch retain a hard halt
Daily loss cancels the remaining virtual entry before later trade evidence
Protective sells survive risk cancellation; trigger latency and stop-limit gaps remain
Crash before cursor/commit rolls back valuation, venue effects and propagated risk; post-commit recovery is idempotent
Contributions and withdrawals preserve unit price and latches
Unread replay or unposted fills veto cash flows and epoch reviews
Missing midnight is suspended; exact midnight establishes a baseline
Daily baseline propagation preserves operator hard-halt reasons
Interrupted held-asset evidence retains incomplete_since after recovery
Hashes, policy, NAV arithmetic, cursor/source agreement and source coverage are audited
Legacy accounts explicitly add a flat baseline without resetting an existing cursor
Bounded read-only valuation pages use Decimal strings and source-number cursors
verification_findings_resolved: Native smoke initially addressed an older installed wheel; reinstalled and validated the final package in Linux
A loss/rebound fixture was inside the protective child latency window; moved its observations after the existing delay
Delayed heartbeats retain the prior economic time and omit NAV instead of repricing from future books
Midnight fixtures cannot use tomorrow-dated public receipts; tested the shared historical clock transition directly
Historical daily baseline and control propagation preserve operator halts and review chronology
limits: Finite flat-account run, not evidence of signal-driven episodes, alpha or 56-day reliability
Per-receipt evidence, full-prefix audits and SQL query cost grow; resource/archive/retention qualification remains required
Baseline starts at explicit flat/reconciled enrolment; no prior performance is reconstructed
All valuation pages remain provisional; no full tax or performance rebuild is implemented
remaining: Full accounting/performance workflows and historical report rebuild
